name: creative_briefs_v1
description: 10 creative-operations briefs spanning the major brief classes a brand/marketing team brainstorms. Each prompt asks for N distinct directions on a specific brief; the right side scoring rubric weights specificity + creativity + on-topic.

prompts.brief: Give me a creative logo for an engineering club at Stanford. I want a three-sentence visual description suitable for an image-generation prompt.
Design a logo direction for a new DTC skincare brand that wants to feel slow-craft and apothecary, not wellness-startup. Give a memorable concept name and a one-paragraph visual description.

Concept directions for a Q3 launch campaign for a sustainable trail-runner shoe. Target: urban runners who want one shoe for road and trail. Give a memorable campaign name and a paragraph describing the concept.
Generate creative concept directions for a campaign that needs to build trust in a new consumer fintech app. Each direction has a name and a paragraph describing the central insight and execution.

Packaging directions for a premium oat milk reformulation. Refrigerated case, $7-9 carton, aimed at independent grocery and DTC subscription. Each direction has a name and a paragraph describing the physical form and surface design.
Packaging directions for a natural deodorant brand. Plastic-free is required. Each direction has a memorable name and a paragraph describing the form factor, materials, and surface.

Generate distinct product naming directions for a new AI workflow tool aimed at product designers. For each: a candidate name and a one-paragraph rationale describing the linguistic root, association, and feel.
Distinct brand name directions for a new specialty coffee subscription. For each, give the candidate name and a paragraph explaining its origin, association, and intended brand feel.

Distinct go-to-market strategy directions for a legal-tech platform pivoting to AI-native. For each: a memorable strategy name and a paragraph covering the customer wedge, proof metric, pricing, and the main risk.

Distinct go-to-market directions for a new B2B SaaS developer-tools company. For each direction: a memorable strategy name and a paragraph covering the customer wedge, the proof point, pricing, and the main risk.
